Dominick (Japanese: トモノ Tomono) is a character of the day who appeared in From Brags to Riches. He is a Pokémon Trainer from Inua Town who took part in the Double Battle rounds of the Ever Grande Conference.

Dominick was one of 's opponents during the conference. He sent out his and against Ash's and . While tried to flood Swalot with , and Tropius went at each other with and and and , respectively. Tropius kept on flying while Torkoal kept using to shield itself. Eventually, both Pokémon ended up knocking each other out.

No matter what attack Corphish unleashed on Swalot, from its Bubble Beam to its , the absorbed all of them. Swalot was also capable of fighting back with its and . Finally, Corphish was capable of protecting itself from the Shock Wave by using its pincers before using Bubble Beam inside of Swalot's mouth. Sure enough, Swalot was sent flying from all of the water inside of it. Ash was declared the victor and moved on to his next battle. Dominick was eliminated from the tournament.
